evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC) 9th Academy 13 Research Institute”, a unit of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC); the list has named it since May 2001, under its current name since a 2019 revision. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
